metadata.estilo: ilustração infantil consistente com o SayIt!
metadata.excecao_texto_na_imagem: Letras ou números podem aparecer somente quando forem essenciais para representar o conceito, como em alphabet. Não escrever a palavra-alvo nem frases.

imagens.descricao_visual: One ripe purple plum fruit with a small green leaf.
One elegant fluffy curved feather, a decorative plume, vivid teal blue, single feather clearly visible.
One simple empty round ceramic dinner dish, viewed slightly from above.
One simple wooden hairbrush with visible soft bristles.
Two ripe red cherries joined by green stems and a leaf.
One ripe orange-pink peach fruit with small leaf, one half showing its stone.
A single human hand with all five anatomically correct fingers, four fingers curled and thumb pointing upwards, clear thumbs-up.
A friendly adult father kneeling beside and gently hugging his young child, showing a caring dad.
A simple freestanding chart board with three different-height colorful vertical bars on two axes. No numbers or letters.
One perfectly round smooth blue geometric sphere with soft highlight and shadow, not a circle or disc.

Use case: scientific-educational. Square vocabulary flashcard illustration for children's English learning app. A friendly adult police officer in blue uniform with cap and small badge, full body, relaxed helpful pose. Clean soft 3D clay illustration, white background, centered, simple readable silhouette. No weapon, no text, no letters, no watermark. Meaning: COP, policial.

Use case: scientific-educational. Square vocabulary flashcard illustration for children's English learning app illustrating the verb COPE: a child calmly taking a deep breath and patiently working through a difficult jigsaw puzzle at a small table, a few pieces remain. Face looks determined and calm, not distressed. Clean soft 3D clay illustration, white background, centered, minimal scene, readable at small sizes. No text, no letters, no watermark.
